# Nick Anderson

> https://www.nickanderson.us/

Personal site of Nick Anderson, a PhD candidate in Economics at The New School
for Social Research. Empirical work on public finance and economic history,
and the construction of long-run economic data. This site is the author anchor
of the Heterodata research-data ecosystem.

## Pages

- Home: https://www.nickanderson.us/ — index of projects and sites
- Research: https://www.nickanderson.us/research.html — three papers: Duration and Public Finance (2001-2023), Tax Revenue Cyclicality (1800-2020), and the US-Germany balance of payments
- Economic History: https://www.nickanderson.us/economichistory.html — the original figures and full treatment of the research papers
- Economics at The New School: https://www.nickanderson.us/tnse.html — institutional history and the Anwar Shaikh Papers
- AI Tools: https://www.nickanderson.us/aitools.html — open-source research tooling
- Projects: https://www.nickanderson.us/projects.html — sites and repositories
- Data: https://www.nickanderson.us/data.html — datasets, mirrors, and downloads
- About: https://www.nickanderson.us/about.html
- Contact: https://www.nickanderson.us/contact.html

## Data
